title: Callstack Lens: correlated request exploration & span grouping
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a 'Callstack Lens' exploration surface inside the Redwood Console tracing view that helps engineers quickly pivot from a high-level request timeline to correlated request groups, span clusters, and inferred causal edges. This ticket covers: (1) a compact summary row for correlation IDs that surfaces repeat frequency and error rate, (2) a collapsible span-clustering view that groups by logical stages (decode, kv-cache, compile, kernel), (3) an interactive timeline scrubber with relative time deltas between spans and requests, and (4) filters to pivot by sampling rate, model variant, region, and rollout tag. The goal is to reduce MTTI for production incidents and make tracing useful for non-trace experts on SRE and product teams.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows correlation-ID summary row with count, error %, p50/p95 latency and top 3 failing spans
Span groups can be expanded/collapsed and show aggregated duration and hit count
Timeline scrubber supports comparing two timestamps and shows delta + async gaps between spans
Filters include: sample rate, model ID, region, deployment tag, and can be combined
Interactions documented in Confluence with handoff notes for engineering (data requirements + APIs)
Usability test with at least 3 engineers yields average task completion time < 6 minutes for a common triage flow
design_notes: Use a horizontal 'lens' overlay that pins to the selected request row, avoiding full-page context switch
Span clustering heuristic: primary by span.name, secondary by host+pool, tertiary by KV cache hit/miss metadata
Visual encoding: duration = width, count = badge number, error = red left stripe, cache-hit = subtle green chevron
Allow switching between absolute timeline and relative (first-span-zero) to compare cold vs warm paths
Provide an option to 'promote' a repeated correlation group to a saved investigation (creates linkable query + time window)
Accessibility: ensure keyboard navigation for expanding groups and a11y labels on scrubber handles
decisions: Chosen overlay lens rather than separate details page to minimize context switching (PM + Eng consensus 2026-03-03)
Aggregate span groups in UI but require raw span streaming in backend for drilldown (engineering constraint)
Expose rollout tag filter first: will help debug canary regressions without needing model-level logs
Sampling-aware counts: UI will show estimates with a sample-rate badge and link to exact query parameters
feedback: PM review (2026-03-04): Add quick 'jump to logs' action on failing span
SRE review (2026-03-05): Prefer relative time by default when comparing repeated requests
Engineering (runtime) review (2026-03-06): Backend must return span causality hints to render inferred edges; otherwise show 'inference unavailable' state
Design critique (2026-03-09): Reduce visual noise by collapsing span metadata behind a hover-to-expand pattern
next_steps: Incorporate SRE feedback and produce second-fidelity prototype (due 2026-03-15)
Create engineering ticket for backend contract: ENG-41234 (include sample payload + retention requirements)
Schedule 30m handoff with runtime team to review span causality API and sampling semantics
Add two small UI acceptance tests to the console e2e suite: lens open/close + filter persistence
